events.text: Amtrak placed first order for 40 SDP40F locomotives.

evidence.quote: The first order , placed on November 2 , 1972 , was for 40 locomotives

events.text: EMD began building SDP40F locomotives for Amtrak.

evidence.quote: built by General Motors Electro-Motive Division ( EMD ) from 1973–1974

events.text: SDP40F locomotives entered Amtrak revenue service.

evidence.quote: The locomotives entered revenue service on June 22 , 1973

events.text: Amtrak placed second order for 110 SDP40F locomotives.

evidence.quote: A second order , for 110 locomotives at $50 million , followed on October 12 , 1973

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Amtrak decided to abandon SDP40F in favor of the F40PH.

evidence.quote: In 1977 Amtrak decided to move on from the SDP40F in favor of the EMD F40PH
In the spring of 1977 Amtrak faced a power crisis

events.text: Amtrak traded 40 SDP40F locomotives back to EMD.

evidence.quote: In the spring of 1977 Amtrak faced a power crisis

events.text: Amtrak traded 132 SDP40F locomotives back to EMD for F40PHRs, through 1987.

evidence.quote: Between 1977–1987 Amtrak traded 132 of the SDP40Fs back to EMD for F40PHRs

events.text: Amtrak traded 18 SDP40F locomotives to Santa Fe for 43 switchers.

evidence.quote: In 1984 Amtrak , low on light-duty power , traded 18 SDP40Fs to the Santa Fe for 43 switchers

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Last SDP40F locomotives left the Amtrak roster.

evidence.quote: The last SDP40Fs left the Amtrak roster in 1987

events.label: retirement
events.text: BNSF retired the rebuilt SDF40-2 locomotives.
